title: The Santa Claus Brownies
summary: "The Santa Claus Brownies" by Ethel Calvert Phillips is a collection of children's stories written in the early 20th century. The stories explore themes of kindness, creativity, and the magic of the holiday season. Subsequent tales include a lesson on responsibility with the Little Brown Boy learning to pick up after himself and discovering the importance of his toys and the touching story of Merrythought, a Brownie who rediscovers the true spirit of Christmas by bringing joy to children who have none.
